correctness.rationale: The centrally symmetric boundary-cover criterion reduces the claim to exact finite conditions. All six normalized centers are boundary points; all 15 pairwise differences avoid the interior; and all 14 facets are covered by a deterministic exact-rational triangulation certificate. The certificate has 438 terminal triangles, maximum depth 3, and minimum strict inequality slack 1/16. Convexity upgrades certified triangle vertices to full triangle containment. The packaged checker replays these facts without floating-point scientific comparisons.

value.rationale: The regular truncated octahedron is a canonical centrally symmetric Archimedean solid and a space-filling polytope. Six blockers reach the conjectural 2d benchmark as an explicit upper bound in dimension three without assuming the conjectural lower bound. The rational witness has positive clearance and therefore supplies a robust, reproducible construction rather than a numerical approximation.
